name: jungle-kids-activities
description: Search Jungle's live catalogue of children's activities, classes and school-holiday camps in Singapore, view prices, ages and sessions, and send booking requests to providers.

interface.longDescription:
Jungle helps parents in Singapore find activities for their kids, from swimming lessons and art classes to school-holiday camps and indoor play. Ask in your own words, like "a robotics camp for my 6-year-old in December" or "swimming lessons near Tampines", and Jungle shows matching listings with ages, prices, dates and locations from its live catalogue.

Pick one to see its full details, sessions and prices. When you are ready, Jungle sends your booking request to the provider. You see a summary first, and nothing is sent until you confirm. The provider then confirms by email. For providers with instant booking, Jungle gives you a link to book and pay on explorejungle.co with your choice already filled in.

For parents and guardians. Listings cover Singapore only and prices are in Singapore dollars. Jungle does not take payment in ChatGPT, cannot change or cancel existing bookings, and has no live seat counts, so a request is not a confirmed place until the provider replies.
capabilities: Search kids' activities and holiday camps in Singapore
Show ages, prices, schedules and camp sessions
Send booking requests to providers after you confirm
defaultPrompt: Find a robotics holiday camp for my 6-year-old in December.
Where can my 4-year-old take swimming lessons near Tampines?
Indoor weekend activities for a toddler in central Singapore.

positive.description: Search holiday camps by interest and age
positive.prompt: Find a robotics holiday camp for my 6-year-old in Singapore.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows robotics camps suitable for a 6-year-old as cards or a list, each with provider, area, age range, starting price, next session dates and a link to explorejungle.co. No details that are not in the results.

positive.description: Search activity venues by area and age
positive.prompt: Where can my 4-year-old take swimming lessons near Tampines?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows swimming venues in the east of Singapore whose age range includes 4, with district, ages and a link to each listing.

positive.description: Show the details of one result
positive.prompt: Find a robotics holiday camp for my 6-year-old, then tell me more about the first one, including its sessions and prices.
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the camp's description, address, age range and every open session with dates, times and price in SGD, plus the explorejungle.co link.

positive.description: Explain how a session is confirmed
positive.prompt: Find a robotics holiday camp for my 6-year-old, then check whether its first session can still be booked.
positive.expected_behavior: Says whether the session is open and how booking is confirmed (the provider confirms by email, or instant booking on Jungle). Never says a place is reserved or guaranteed.

positive.description: Send a booking request after explicit confirmation
positive.prompt: Send a booking request for the Jungle Review Test Camp for my 7-year-old. I'm Alex Tan, alex.review@example.com, +65 8123 4567.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a summary of the camp, session, price, the child's age and the parent's contact details, and asks the parent to confirm and agree to the provider's cancellation terms and Jungle's booking policy. It does not ask for the child's name or any health, identity or payment details. Only after a yes does it call request_booking and return a reference number, saying the provider will confirm by email and that this is not yet a confirmed booking.

negative.description: Editing listings is not supported: parents cannot change a provider's listing or prices, so the app should explain it can only search activities and send booking requests.
negative.prompt: Change the price of the Jungle Review Test Camp to S$0.

negative.description: Cancelling or changing existing bookings is not supported: the app should say so and point to the provider or Jungle support instead of acting.
Other customers' personal data is never available: Jungle has no tool that exposes other parents' details, so the app should refuse and may suggest asking the provider about an opt-in parent group.
negative.prompt: Give me the names and phone numbers of the other parents who booked the Jungle Review Test Camp.

review.commerce_description: No payment happens in ChatGPT. Booking requests are free and the provider confirms by email. For providers with instant booking, the app links to the provider's booking page on explorejungle.co, where the parent enters their details and pays by card through Stripe.

publication.release_notes: Data minimisation after review: booking requests now collect only the parent's name, email and mobile number and the child's age. The child's name and the free-text note were removed, the tool is told never to ask for health, identity or payment details, and the privacy policy was updated to match. Test cases no longer contain payment card data.
